# Odette Pullen

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c6 P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004), [v3 c39 P19](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0019)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Odette has a tranquil, pleasant, and rosy-faced appearance. She has plump hands and lacks a particularly imposing figure.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P46](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0046), [v3 c39 P20](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0020), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_

## Personality

Odette possesses a gentle, calm, and pleasant disposition. She is uncorrupted by wealth, lacks malice, and avoids saying things that might hurt others' feelings. Practical and straightforward, she approaches her responsibilities in a relaxed manner without lofty ambitions or high-minded ideals. She is not considered especially clever, but she remains loyal and enthusiastically supportive of her longtime friends.

_Sources: [v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002), [v2 c4 P8](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0008), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_

## Traits

- Gentle  <sub>[v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)</sub>
- Tranquil  <sub>[v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)</sub>
- Pragmatic  <sub>[v2 c4 P8](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0008)</sub>

## Abilities

- Skilled at cooking  <sub>[v3 c39 P27](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0027)</sub>

## Goals

- Earn her pay honestly and satisfy the school board  <sub>[v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002)</sub>

## History

Flora Odette Pullen grew up in the local community, spending her youth alongside classmates such as Nell Harcourt. As a schoolgirl, she participated in social gatherings and outdoor games with her peers, including a garden party where she attempted physical challenges proposed by her friends. Following her schooling, she took up a teaching position in Stonebridge, advocating a straightforward approach to classroom discipline. Later, after returning from out West, she became engaged to Mr. Inglis, a wealthy former miner from Winnipeg. Following their grand wedding, she traveled to Europe for her honeymoon before settling into a large estate in Winnipeg. Despite her elevated social standing and luxurious lifestyle, she remained unpretentious and returned to visit her old friends, showing great excitement for Nell's upcoming wedding.

_Sources: [v1 c6 P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004), [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002), [v3 c39 P19](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0019), [v3 c39 P20](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0020), [v3 c39 P27](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0027), [v3 c39 P35](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0035), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_
